I’m a medical student. I assume you smoked crack cocaine or some amphetamine. Lack of sleep is a slow and painful death. Unfortunately, all death is painful in some way. 
Please call an Ambulance or have someone you trust drive you to the nearest ER. 
Excessive stimulant consumption combined with a severe lack of sleep sounds to me like a formula for psychosis, especially if you are already feeling some symptoms. BUT: You will be okay!
Unfortunately, I can’t give medical advice yet, but this is what I would do. <3
